bundle-size.input: frontend production build (npm run build) with VITE_API_URL unset; sizes of the files in dist, brotli quality 11 and gzip level 9

page-load.method: median of 5 cold loads per page in Playwright Chromium; LCP, CLS and FCP from web-vitals; TBT from long tasks after FCP within 10000 ms; the try-on reads the stand-in clip as its camera

budgets.basis: Lab numbers, not field data: median of five cold loads in Chromium 159 with a 4x CPU slowdown and a 9 Mbit/s, 40 ms link. Measured on an Apple M4 Pro (run page-load in results.json) and in an emulated x86 Linux container with 2 CPUs: catalogue LCP 544 and 552 ms, try-on LCP 604 and 624 ms, CLS 0.030 and 0.028 on the try-on and 0 on the catalogue, TBT 0 ms. The budgets sit under the web.dev good thresholds (LCP 2500 ms, CLS 0.1, TBT 200 ms) with at least twice the measured LCP and three times the measured CLS, so a slower runner does not fail a build and a regression of that size does.
